layers (L1--L3) at higher bit-widths while compressing mid-layers (L5--L11) more aggressively---a redistribution that standard profiling misses because its distortion estimates for these heads fall to calibration sampling noise.\n28\t\n29\t\\paragraph{Numerical precision.}\n30\tFloat32 profiling (64 $\\times$ 2048 tokens) yields an identical constrained allocation and PPL within seed variance
